name: Lx
description: domain length in x (direction of the regional gradient)

name: grad_regional
description: regional hydraulic gradient from left to right

name: h_ref
description: prescribed head at the left boundary

name: rho_c_s
description: volumetric heat capacity of the rock matrix

name: dt_safety
description: fraction of the explicit stability limit used as dt

name: T_drop_crit
description: production temperature drop that defines thermal breakthrough

name: lambda_cap
description: cap/base rock thermal conductivity (0 = disabled i.e. adiabatic top/bottom as before #4)

name: rho_c_cap
description: volumetric heat capacity of the cap/base rock (only used when lambda_cap > 0)

name: n_z_cap
description: number of 1D conduction layers modelled per side (cap and base share one symmetric stack)

name: dz_cap0
description: thickness of the cap/base layer nearest the aquifer

name: dz_cap_growth
description: geometric growth factor for successive cap/base layers (keeps the far layer's fixed-T_res boundary beyond the diffusion length)
